0022600121.text: The Celtics (1-1, third in the Atlantic and sixth in the East) host the Chicago Bulls (1-1, second in the Central and seventh in the East) in Boston's third game of the season, with Boston coming off a win and Devin Carter out with an illness. Chicago is also missing Nic Claxton (hamstring), Noa Essengue (head bruise), and Patrick Williams (groin soreness). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Boston won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, including a 124-105 win in Boston on February 11, 2026.
